channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Death toll from Russian strike on Ukrainian arms depot rises to 38
item.description: Russia's Defence Ministry announces plans to launch 'massive strikes' against Ukraine's infrastructure before winter.

item.title: How has life changed for Iranians six months into the war?
item.description: Common Iranians are under increasing pressure, with no relief expected in the short term.

item.title: Six months on, what did the strikes on Iran achieve?
item.description: The US-Israeli bombing of Iran became a fight for the Strait of Hormuz. AJLabs counts the cost of the war.

item.title: Iran’s Khamenei calls for Gulf unity as Hormuz tensions persist
item.description: Khamenei urges Gulf rulers to confront their 'real enemy' as Iran keeps Hormuz restricted amid stalled diplomacy.

item.title: The home front: How Israel, Iran, and US leaders have been hit by the war
item.description: Six months into the US-Israel war on Iran, the governments in the three countries are fighting political wars at home.

item.title: One person killed, five wounded in shooting at rave in Switzerland
item.description: Police said a manhunt is under way following the incident at the annual techno party.

item.title: Somali piracy surges as the impact of the US-Iran war ripples outwards
item.description: Two ships were seized within four days last week raising to at least 13 the number attacked since January.

item.title: Deadly strike on Kyiv warehouse prompts evacuations
item.description: Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv after the deadly strike, which authorities said killed more than 30 people.

item.title: BBC tracks one week of Israeli settler violence in occupied West Bank
item.description: The BBC's Lucy Williamson reports on settler attacks on Palestinians, which have been observed over the last week alone.
